equity.level_reason: Guideline attainment is reported by an ordered education gradient and described as increasing, but values are only set side by side with CIs; no computed difference or ratio and no disparity framing.

level_alternative.reason: Education is the stratifying exposure and is itself a social determinant, so the 12.2% vs 33.6% contrast could be read as a quantified contrast meeting level 3.

equity.equity_measurement: Education levels only; number of categories inferred from the figure description and text (lowest: high school or less, highest: bachelor's or higher).

ev.q: The percentage of adults who met these guidelines increased with increasing educational attainment

notes: QuickStats figure only; number of education groups not given in text (likely 3). Survey weighting is implied by NHIS but not stated, so not recorded as a procedure.
view_issues: Figure values for the middle education group(s) are not in the text.
